sentence: Myself Karthik, I am coming from Madurai.
expected_correction: I am Karthik, and I come from Madurai. (or: My name is Karthik. I come from Madurai.)
tamil_context: தன் அறிமுகத்தில் 'Myself' கூடாது; சொந்த ஊரைக் குறிப்பிட 'I come from' அல்லது 'I am from' சிறந்தது.
chatgpt_output:
I am Karthik. I come from Madurai. 
Explanation: 'Myself' is a reflexive pronoun and cannot be the subject of a sentence. Also, 'I come from' is preferred for permanent origins over 'I am coming from'.
chatgpt_evaluation: Accurate correction and clear grammar explanation.
gemini_output:
My name is Karthik, and I am from Madurai. 
Explanation in Tamil: என்னை அறிமுகப்படுத்த 'Myself' பயன்படாது. 'I am' அல்லது 'My name is' என்று கூற வேண்டும்.
gemini_evaluation: Excellent inclusion of Tamil explanation; polite and accurate.
claude_output:
I am Karthik, and I come from Madurai. 
Note: While 'I am coming from' can mean traveling right now, 'I come from' denotes your hometown.
claude_evaluation: Nuanced distinction between present continuous travel vs hometown origin.
google_translate_crosscheck: நானே கார்த்திக், மதுரையிலிருந்து வருகிறேன் (Literal translation retains grammatical flaw).
common_ai_pitfalls: Some AI models overly accept 'Myself' as informal spoken English without flagging it for Indian ESL beginners.
human_reviewed_answer: I am Karthik, and I am from Madurai.

sentence: One of my friend is working in TCS company.
target_rule: Partitive Concord (One of + Plural Noun) & Redundancy ('TCS company')
expected_correction: One of my friends works at TCS. (or: One of my friends is working at TCS.)
tamil_context: 'One of my friends' - நண்பர்களில் ஒருவர் என்பதால் 'friends' பன்மை வர வேண்டும்; 'TCS' என்றாலே நிறுவனம் என்பதால் 'company' தேவையற்றது.
chatgpt_output:
One of my friends works at TCS. 
Explanation: After 'one of my', use plural 'friends'. 'At TCS' is preferred over 'in TCS company'.
chatgpt_evaluation: Correct on plural concord; neatly simplifies 'TCS company'.
gemini_output:
One of my friends is working at TCS. 
Tamil: 'One of my' அடுத்து 'friends' (பன்மை) வர வேண்டும், ஆனால் வினைச்சொல் 'is' (ஒருமை).
gemini_evaluation: Clearly articulates the singular verb agreement in Tamil.
claude_output: One of my friends works at TCS (or for TCS). 'Company' is redundant after TCS.
claude_evaluation: Strong stylistic guidance on prepositions (at/for) and acronym redundancy.
google_translate_crosscheck: என் நண்பர்களில் ஒருவர் டிசிஎஸ் நிறுவனத்தில் பணிபுரிகிறார்.
common_ai_pitfalls: Some models change 'is' to 'are' thinking 'friends' is the subject.
human_reviewed_answer: One of my friends works at TCS.

sentence: She do not knows the answer for this question.
target_rule: Subject-Verb Agreement (Auxiliary 'does not') & Base Verb Rule
expected_correction: She does not know the answer to this question.
tamil_context: 'She' க்கு 'does not' வர வேண்டும்; அதன்பின் 'know' என்ற மூல வினைச்சொல் மட்டுமே வரும் ('s' கூடாது); 'answer to this question' என்பதே முறையான முன்னிடைச்சொல்.
chatgpt_output:
She does not know the answer to this question. 
Explanation: 'She' requires 'does not', followed by the base verb 'know'. Use 'answer to', not 'answer for'.
chatgpt_evaluation: Catches both the double-marking on 'knows' and preposition 'to'.
gemini_output:
She does not know the answer to this question. 
விளக்கம்: 'She' உடன் 'does not' வர வேண்டும். அதன்பின் 's' நீக்கப்பட்டு 'know' மட்டுமே வரும்.
gemini_evaluation: Clear breakdown of rule in Tamil and English.
claude_output:
She does not know the answer to this question. 
Two errors: (1) 'do not knows' -> 'does not know'; (2) 'answer for' -> 'answer to'.
claude_evaluation: Systematic enumeration of both discrete errors.
common_ai_pitfalls: Some basic models fix 'do' to 'does' but accidentally leave 'knows' unchanged.
human_reviewed_answer: She does not know the answer to this question.

sentence: I am having two brother and one sister.
expected_correction: I have two brothers and one sister.
tamil_context: உடன்பிறப்புகளைக் குறிப்பிட 'I have' எனப் பயன்படும்; 'I am having' என்பது தவறு. 'two brothers' என பன்மை வர வேண்டும்.
chatgpt_output:
I have two brothers and one sister. 
Explanation: 'Have' indicating possession/relationship should not be in continuous form ('having'). 'Brother' must be plural ('brothers').
chatgpt_evaluation: Accurately identifies stative verb usage and plural noun error.
gemini_output:
I have two brothers and one sister. 
தமிழ் விளக்கம்: ஆங்கிலத்தில் உடன்பிறப்புகள் அல்லது உடைமைகளுக்கு 'I have' என்றுதான் சொல்ல வேண்டும்; 'am having' என்று சொல்லக்கூடாது.
gemini_evaluation: Very clear Tamil explanation directly addressing L1 language transfer.
claude_output:
I have two brothers and a sister. 
Note: 'Having' implies eating or undergoing an event, not family relationships.
claude_evaluation: Helpful semantic note about 'having lunch' vs 'having a brother'.
google_translate_crosscheck: எனக்கு இரண்டு சகோதரர்களும் ஒரு சகோதரியும் உள்ளனர்.
common_ai_pitfalls: Some casual AI systems allow 'I am having' treating it as acceptable informal regional dialect.
human_reviewed_answer: I have two brothers and one sister.

sentence: Yesterday night he did not went to college.
target_rule: Time Phrase Collocation ('Last night') & Auxiliary + Base Verb ('did not go')
expected_correction: Last night he did not go to college. (or: Yesterday he did not go to college.)
tamil_context: ஆங்கிலத்தில் 'Yesterday night' என்று கூறுவதில்லை; 'Last night' என்பதே சரியான வழக்கு. 'did not' அடுத்து 'go' என்ற மூல வினைச்சொல் வர வேண்டும்.
chatgpt_output:
Last night he did not go to college. 
Explanation: Say 'last night' rather than 'yesterday night'. After 'did not', use the base verb 'go', not past tense 'went'.
chatgpt_evaluation: Correctly fixes both collocation and auxiliary verb error.
gemini_output:
Last night, he did not go to college. 
தமிழ்: 'Yesterday night' என்பதற்கு பதில் 'Last night' கூற வேண்டும்; 'did not' வந்தால் 'went' அல்ல, 'go' மட்டுமே வரும்.
gemini_evaluation: Pinpoints the exact Tamil linguistic instinct (நேற்று இரவு -> Yesterday night).
claude_output:
Last night he didn't go to college. 
Key point: Double past tense ('did' + 'went') is ungrammatical; use 'did not go'.
claude_evaluation: Strong explanation of the 'double past' grammatical trap.
common_ai_pitfalls: Occasional AI answers retain 'Yesterday night' without marking it as non-standard.
human_reviewed_answer: Last night he did not go to college.

sentence: Please revert back to my email as soon as possible.
expected_correction: Please reply to my email as soon as possible. (or: Please respond to my email...)
tamil_context: 'Revert' என்பதே திரும்புதல் அல்லது பதிலளித்தல் ஆகும்; அதனுடன் 'back' சேர்ப்பது தேவையில்லாத சொல் இரட்டிப்பு.
chatgpt_output:
Please reply to my email as soon as possible. 
Explanation: 'Revert back' is redundant because 'revert' already contains the sense of return. In business English, 'reply' or 'respond' is standard.
chatgpt_evaluation: Clear explanation of lexical redundancy and professional phrasing.
gemini_output:
Please reply to my email as soon as possible. 
விளக்கம்: 'Revert back' என்பது இந்திய ஆங்கிலத்தில் அடிக்கடி பயன்படும் பிழை. 'Reply' அல்லது 'Respond' என்று எழுதவும்.
gemini_evaluation: Explicitly highlights this as a common Indian English workplace issue.
claude_output:
Please respond to my email as soon as possible. 
'Revert' means to return to a previous state. Use 'reply' or 'respond' when asking for an email answer.
claude_evaluation: Technically precise on the true dictionary meaning of 'revert'.
common_ai_pitfalls: Some models suggest 'Please revert to my email' which is still unnatural compared to 'reply'.
human_reviewed_answer: Please reply to my email as soon as possible.

sentence: He gave me a good advice for my final semester exam.
target_rule: Uncountable Noun Rule ('Advice' cannot take indefinite article 'a')
expected_correction: He gave me good advice for my final semester exam. (or: ...a piece of good advice...)
tamil_context: 'Advice' என்பது எண்ண முடியாத பெயர்ச்சொல் (uncountable noun). எனவே 'a advice' என்று வரக் கூடாது; 'good advice' அல்லது 'a piece of advice' என்று கூற வேண்டும்.
chatgpt_output:
He gave me good advice for my final semester exam. 
Explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable, so you cannot say 'a advice'. Use 'some advice' or 'a piece of advice'.
gemini_output:
He gave me some good advice for my final semester exam. 
தமிழ்: 'Advice' என்பது எண்ண முடியாத சொல். எனவே 'a advice' எனக் கூறக் கூடாது. 'good advice' அல்லது 'some advice' எனலாம்.
gemini_evaluation: Provides both 'some good advice' and 'a piece of advice' options.
claude_output: He gave me a piece of good advice for my final semester exam (or simply: good advice).
claude_evaluation: Offers both native collocations with clear explanation.
google_translate_crosscheck: எனது இறுதிப் பருவத் தேர்வுக்கு அவர் எனக்கு ஒரு நல்ல ஆலோசனையை வழங்கினார்.
common_ai_pitfalls: Google Translate and poorly tuned models translate 'a advice' literally as 'ஒரு ஆலோசனை', reinforcing the misconception.
human_reviewed_answer: He gave me good advice for my final semester exam.

sentence: Why you are sitting outside the classroom?
expected_correction: Why are you sitting outside the classroom?
tamil_context: கேள்விகளில் துணை வினைச்சொல் (are) எழுவாய்க்கு (you) முன்பாக வர வேண்டும். 'Why you are...' என்று பேசுவது தவறு.
chatgpt_output:
Why are you sitting outside the classroom? 
Explanation: In Wh-questions, invert the auxiliary verb and subject: 'Why are you...', not 'Why you are...'.
chatgpt_evaluation: Spot-on explanation of subject-verb inversion in questions.
gemini_output:
Why are you sitting outside the classroom? 
தமிழ் விளக்கம்: கேள்விகளில் 'are' என்ற துணை வினைச்சொல் 'you' க்கு முன்பாக வர வேண்டும்.
claude_output:
Why are you sitting outside the classroom? 
Subject-auxiliary inversion is mandatory for direct questions.
common_ai_pitfalls: Models may fail to point out that 'Why you are sitting...' is valid only as an embedded clause (e.g. 'I know why you are sitting...').
human_reviewed_answer: Why are you sitting outside the classroom?

sentence: My cousin brother is staying in hostel.

expected_correction: My cousin is staying in a hostel. (or: My cousin lives in a hostel.)

chatgpt_output:
My cousin is staying in a hostel. 
Explanation: 'Cousin brother' is Indian English; standard English uses 'cousin'. Also add the article 'a' before 'hostel'.
chatgpt_evaluation: Detects both the kinship lexical redundancy and missing article.
gemini_output:
My cousin is staying in a hostel. 
தமிழ்: ஆங்கிலத்தில் 'cousin' என்று சொன்னாலே போதுமானது; 'brother' சேர்க்கக் கூடாது. மேலும் 'in a hostel' என்று 'a' சேர்க்க வேண்டும்.
gemini_evaluation: Clear explanation of both errors in Tamil.
claude_output: My cousin is staying in a hostel. (If gender matters, specify: 'My male cousin...' or 'My cousin, Ravi, is staying in a hostel.')
claude_evaluation: Adds helpful advice on how to naturally convey gender when necessary.
common_ai_pitfalls: Some AI checkers miss the missing article before 'hostel'.
human_reviewed_answer: My cousin is staying in a hostel.

Although he worked very hard, he failed the exam.

Although he worked very hard, he failed the exam. 
தமிழ்: 'Although' வந்தால் 'but' வரக் கூடாது. இரண்டில் ஏதேனும் ஒன்றை மட்டுமே பயன்படுத்த வேண்டும்.
gemini_evaluation: Accurately targets the Tamil translation transfer (இருப்பினும்... ஆனால்).
